guidance.heading: 2026 BUSINESS OUTLOOK
section: The Company is raising 2026 full year adjusted sales and adjusted EPS guidance. The Company now expects 2026 adjusted sales to be between $7.55 billion to $7.60 billion versus prior guidance of $7.30 billion to $7.50 billion. The Company now expects adjusted EPS of $3.50 to $3.60 versus prior guidance of $3.00 to $3.10, of which approximately $1.09 is attributed to the benefit of tariff refunds recorded in the second and third quarters of 2026.
